summary:
Detailed report on diagnosing and resolving the TradingBot chart detection issue:
1. Root cause analysis of why pure black/white screens waited while any colorful screen falsely triggered UP/DOWN.
2. Full multi-stage computer vision candlestick morphology algorithm (solid canvas histogram, geometric candle body bounds [2-20px], 1-2px axial wicks, sequential horizontal timeline, and price dispersion).
3. Elimination of stale frames, sequence ID guards, and instant cache/timer wiping on scan stop.
4. Comprehensive verification across all 7 scenarios specified by the user.
